verdict.rationale: Kick documents an MCP interface where 'Your AI can query transactions, generate reports, and update bookkeeping — all with your approval' and works with 'any MCP-compatible assistant,' plus a Google Sheets AI integration where live report data can be reasoned over by Gemini/Claude/ChatGPT — both plausibly support a natural-language 'can we afford X?' query grounded in live ledger data. However, there is no dedicated public REST/GraphQL API (openapi probes all 404), no worked example of an affordability-style query/answer, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that this works in practice. Missing for 10: a documented public API (vs MCP-only), a concrete example of grounded financial Q&A, and third-party verification of accuracy.
